name: Band Camp Boyfriend
source:
For the last few years, the Blue Mountain Bandits High School Marching Band has suffered from inconsistent directorship. Students are dropping out, scores and morale are at an all-time low, and the school doesn’t give the music program the respect it deserves.

Determined to turn everything around, Cadence enters her junior year as the band’s drum major, alongside brand new band director and Blue Mountain alum, Mr. Victor Wiley. Whipping the band into competition shape is easier said than done, but Cadence and Wiley have the drive and optimism to see the task through.

To focus solely on perfecting this year’s field show, the band leaves behind society to spend two weeks at Camp Bearpaw, a sports compound located amidst the woodsy Pennsylvania countryside. It’s the perfect place to kindle friendships, make memories, grow as a leader, and perhaps even find love in between rehearsals...

However, Band Camp isn’t going to be easy. All choices carry weight and unexplained happenings wait in the wings of the camp. Will Cadence lead her classmates to victory--or watch the entire band fall apart around her?

Band Camp Boyfriend is a classic otome visual novel game as well as the ultimate love letter to marching band itself, an activity held dear by many. It’s a tale of romance and friendship, but also of what marching band means to this group of characters--and to us.

[From [url=https://lovebird-games.itch.io/band-camp-boyfriend] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在过去的几年里，蓝山强盗高中军乐团的指挥不稳定。学生们纷纷退学，成绩和士气空前低落，学校也没有给予音乐项目应有的尊重。

决心扭转一切的Cadence进入大三，担任乐队的鼓手，与全新乐队总监、蓝山校友维克多·威利 (Victor Wiley) 先生并肩作战。让乐队进入竞争状态说起来容易做起来难，但Cadence和Wiley拥有完成任务的动力和乐观精神。

为了专注于完善今年的现场表演，乐队离开社会，在熊掌营度过了两周，这是一个位于宾夕法尼亚州森林茂密的乡村的体育中心。这里是点燃友谊、留下回忆、成长为领导者、甚至可能在排练间隙找到爱情的完美场所……

然而，乐队训练营并不容易。所有的选择都有分量，而无法解释的事件则在营地的两侧等待着。韵律会带领她的同学取得胜利，还是眼睁睁地看着她周围的整个乐队分崩离析？

Band Camp Boyfriend是一款经典的乙女视觉小说游戏，也是写给军乐队本身的终极情书，这是一项深受许多人喜爱的活动。这是一个关于浪漫和友谊的故事，同时也讲述了军乐队对这群角色以及我们的意义。

[来自[url=https://lovebird-games.itch.io/band-camp-boyfriend] itch.io[/url]]
